item.title: Iran slams US as ‘main trainer of terrorism’ over claims against Tehran
item.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesman Esmail Baghaei, in a post on X, rejected US claims against Iran over terrorism, saying Washington, as the world’s “main trainer and sponsor of terrorism,” has no legitimacy to set criteria for defining terrorism. [09/12/2026 04:58 ب.ظ ] Hamid Reza Babaee: Iran FM Araghchi: World Losing Confidence in US Financial System Day by Day Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, in a post on X, said the US Treasury Secretary’s efforts to impoverish Iranians and bring Iran’s economy to collapse had instead left him “helpless and powerless” before public opinion, while the world is increasingly losing confidence in the US financial system
item.content:encoded:
